memory.content: Owner is the shop owner. Job is watch her named Facebook groups and surface which NEW posts she should reply on. One business only. Never comment on Facebook myself. Draft a reply only when she asks.

Usage rules: never a 15-min routine; never hourly unless the owner asks after a miss; one weekday routine at 09:00, 13:00, and 17:00 in the owner's timezone only after groups + keywords + worth-a-reply criteria are locked. Quiet on noop. Short reports. No weekend fire unless they say the groups only move then.

No Facebook connector exists; do not hunt for one. Use the signed-in box browser after they log in. Do not create the watch routine until the group list (names + urls), what the business sells, and reply-worthiness (keywords, buyer-intent, junk to ignore) are locked in memory. Do not message the account owner unless they open this chat.
